releases.title: New video and camera improvements
notes: A new video shows where Yooba came from in The Gust.
The camera now keeps Yooba in view when he has grown to his biggest size.
At his largest size, the camera no longer drops in tight behind him and loses the view.
During the orb-eating cutscene, the camera stays on Yooba while he speaks instead of cutting to a building.

releases.title: Improvements and fixes
notes: Improvements and fixes.

releases.title: Smoother camera, goals and labels
notes: The camera no longer slips through glass, windows, or trees as you move around.
The screen no longer goes black when the camera is set to its larger size.
The Eat the orb goal now completes when Yooba is on the walkway beside the glass fence.
The waypoint label no longer overlaps the text in the goal panel.

releases.title: Yooba Land: world loading, sound and travel
notes: The world now loads in as you move through it, so going from place to place means less waiting.
The footsteps are gone, so walking around Yooba Land is much quieter.
Cars drive the roads, boats float on the coast and lake, and the plane can take off from Skyport, fly over the world, and land again.
If the game went dark after the credits, it now brings the world back so you can keep playing.

releases.title: The walk home starts here
notes: I am small. I am hungry. Home is that way.
Apples first. Watermelons and pumpkins once I am big enough.
Shake a tree. Things fall out. I eat them.
Every bite makes me bigger.
Cross the bridge and something that looks a lot like me drops out of the sky.
Tap to play turns my sound on. The gear, top left, turns it down.
I travel light. The world comes down a piece at a time while I get ready, so I start sooner.
Past the broken glass there is a whole town. The market pays seeds for food I carry in.
I am not the only Yooba. The others wait at Level Select, and past the glass we walk together. No codes.
Once I have broken out, I start outside the glass. The others are out there already.
Fish! I stand in a ring by the water, cast, wait for the bob and reel. Then I eat it. Or sell it. Old Reed says sit still.
Chapters! The mayor, a farmer and a goatherd who whistles each show me a bit more of the way. Bramley gave me a golden seed. I am not eating it.
Hide my tab and I fall asleep. To walk with a friend on one computer, put two windows side by side, or use two devices.
